mainEntity.name: What types of surfaces can Frasheski Construction restore in the East Bay area?

acceptedAnswer.text: Frasheski Construction can restore a variety of surfaces, including concrete driveways, patios, and walkways, natural stone features, wooden decks and fences, and tile surfaces. We handle projects for both residential and commercial properties in the East Bay, Oakland, Albany, and El Cerrito areas. Our expertise covers common wear and tear, as well as specific damage repairs.
